# contentful_environment_aliases (Data Source)

Retrieves all Contentful Environment Aliases in a space.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "contentful_environment_aliases" "existing" {
  space_id = var.contentful_space_id
}

locals {
  alias_targets = {
    for alias in data.contentful_environment_aliases.existing.environment_aliases :
    alias.environment_alias_id => alias.target_environment_id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `space_id` (String) ID of the space.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `environment_aliases` (Attributes List) Environment aliases in the space, ordered lexicographically by `environment_alias_id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environment_aliases))
- `id` (String) Terraform identifier for this lookup, equal to `space_id`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--environment_aliases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environment_aliases`

Read-Only:

- `environment_alias_id` (String) ID of the environment alias.
- `target_environment_id` (String) ID of the environment reached through this alias.
